sectionDiscovery.notes: Framer wraps all content in <div id='main'>. spaContainerHints empty — [data-framer-name] matches 100+ elements per page, causing over-segmentation. Section discovery relies on detectSpaContainer() + recursive mega-section expansion instead.

images.notes: srcset uses 512w, 1024w, 2048w, 4096w breakpoints. CDN does content negotiation (AVIF > WebP) via Accept header — no format param needed.

animations.notes: Appear animations stored in <script type='framer/appear' id='__framer__appearAnimationsContent'> as JSON. Keys are element hashes matching data-framer-appear-id. Values are per-breakpoint initial/animate states in Framer Motion format. Breakpoints defined in <script id='__framer__breakpoints'>.

quirks.description: All class names use framer-[hash] format that changes on recompile. Never use specific hashed classes in selectors.
quirks.workaround: Use attribute selectors like [class*='framer-'] for structural patterns.

quirks.description: Framer composes visual layers using position:absolute children within a shared parent. Splitting these children into separate sections breaks visual relationships.
quirks.workaround: disableUnwrap is set to true. minExpectedSections triggers deeper container detection.

quirks.description: Framer sites have 6+ levels of div.framer-* nesting. cal.com has elements at depth 14.
quirks.workaround: Use MAX_DEPTH=20. Filter by style significance rather than limiting depth.

quirks.description: Every Framer site wraps all content in <div id='main' data-framer-hydrate-v2='...'>. bodyDirectChildSections is always 1.
quirks.workaround: Use #main as primary container. The generic detectSpaContainer() walk finds the correct section parent.

quirks.description: Framer editor layer names survive to production DOM as data-framer-name attributes (e.g., 'Hero Section', 'Footer Wrapper'). Provides semantic section identification.
quirks.workaround: Use data-framer-name for section labeling during extraction.

quirks.description: Entrance animations stored in <script type='framer/appear'> as JSON keyed by element hash. Values have per-breakpoint initial/animate states with Framer Motion format (opacity, rotate, scale, x, y, transition).
quirks.workaround: Parse the JSON from __framer__appearAnimationsContent. Match elements via data-framer-appear-id.

quirks.description: Framer sites use different breakpoint counts (3-5). Breakpoints defined in <script id='__framer__breakpoints'> with hash-to-media-query mapping. NOT standardized across sites.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
